_readme: Per-repo configuration for the shared gate tests installed from commons (@thiengthb/test-*). Keeping it here means the test files stay byte-identical to the registry copies — an exception is data, never an edit to the check.

no-emoji._allow_note: BURN-DOWN LIST, not approval. These 29 sites predate the gate (installed 2026-07-29) and are listed so the gate can be green on new code while the debt stays visible. app/history/page.tsx was removed from this list once it carried an inline `rulebook-allow: emoji-as-icon — <reason>` directive, which this gate honours. Two groups, and they are NOT the same decision: (a) lib/notify/** is Discord message copy, where emoji may be a deliberate product voice; (b) the rest is in-app UI copy, which the platform rule (lucide icons only, no emoji as an icon-marker) says should be an icon or plain words. Awaiting the supervisor's call on each group; clear an entry as it is cleaned.
